entries.title: The square integral in the block-joining estimate
entries.locator: arXiv:2011.04642v2, section 2.3, proof of Lemma 2, PDF p. 4; unnumbered integral before (7), HTML equation (12). Versioned HTML and PDF text compared; no visual PDF check.
entries.claim: The displayed square integral is evaluated as log(1 + 2A/(8K)), leading to a joining estimate with numerator 8.
entries.problem: The correct integral is log((8K+A)^2 / (8K(8K+2A))). At A=8K it equals log(4/3), whereas the displayed expression is log 3.
entries.correction: PAFY proves the exact integral and a discrete bound retaining the integer floor. Numerator 64 gives a valid summable bound with the same exponent; enlarge the minimum separation constant. This repairs this estimate only.
entries.leanImpact: Use the corrected integral identity and an explicit integer truncation. The comparison and summable-tail argument are written in PAFY. A complete wiki proof of JZG4 uses only PAFY's integral identity, with its own discrete comparison, and not the source's Lemma 2 numerics. No compiled declaration is supplied. The published theorem is not contradicted by this numerical error.

resolution.summary: Evaluate the block integral correctly and enlarge the separation constant.
resolution.impact: The summable bound keeps its exponent; this repairs the cited estimate only.
